latent_dimension: Native numerical covariance rank; no fixed latent cap or prior PCA representation.

diagnostic_control.operation: independent within-assay column permutation after preprocessing
diagnostic_control.interpretation: Preserves marginal shapes while destroying within-assay dependence. Not biological FDR or a condition-valid causal-null test.

runtime: CPU, one BLAS/OpenMP thread per process; original sklearn FastICA limit/tolerance unchanged.
heldout_encoding: (test_X - train_column_means) @ pseudoinverse(train_mixing); verify equality to native standardized training sources.
readouts: Shared source count, per-assay estimated rank, ICA warnings and native graph failures for every run.
Native anonymous graph coefficient matrix, order/sign bookkeeping, finite-value and condition diagnostics; not original-feature causal edges.

Real heldout paired-count cross-assay correlation RMSE for all three assay pairs, compared with zero cross-correlation baseline. Covariance from shared mixing columns; no paired reference used in fitting/selection.

Existing public simulation discovery-state correlations with matched ICA disturbances, full factor counts retained. Descriptive only; no claim that these are causally related latent-state coordinates.
Comparison with independent-column controls without tuning or selecting seeds.
failure_policy: Capture native exceptions and convergence warnings. Preserve a successfully estimated mixing matrix if graph extraction fails. Do not patch native heuristics or discard failed fits.
scope: No new project worlds, locked simulation cohorts, pairing labels, day labels, truth graph, or additional modalities used in training. Published-model replication is separate. Two seeds do not establish statistical reliability.
